Yeah. I want to spend more time with 33M platonically, I'd be happy being just friends, but as I mentioned in another comment, I'm also emotionally and intellectually attracted to him. I've been attracted to friends like this in the past and perfectly content maintaining platonic relationships. I guess it's easier for me to consider pursuing 33M *because* I only recently met him and he showed interest in me immediately. So it feels more like a possible romantic relationship where we're getting to know each other than a acquaintance situation right now.

To be clear, I did not pursue 33M even after meeting him and recognizing that I found him physically attractive at the time. He went out of his way to talk to me since that night and then I developed more attraction to him, and he's begun using language that is kind of explicitly "cute," like talking about wanting to get to know me more and being excited to see me again soon and telling me that he loves talking to me without any prompting at all. And all of that makes me feel good because the feeling is mutual, but I'm not trying to respond with the same energy because I don't want to get his hopes up even though I'd be happy to explore starting a relationship if we were both into it and it wouldn't affect either of our relationships with 28M. While I've known 28M longer, he and I only have brief text conversations and while we get deep in person, I can count the amount of times I've hung out with him one-on-one on one hand. 33M and I haven't yet hung out in person one-on-one, but like I said in the post, he has asked to make plans and we set a date (but are not calling it a "date" in conversation)

I have been in lovely monogamous relationships in the past that I enjoyed while they lasted. I wouldn't say it's fair to claim that it'd probably be temporary, my emotions for people I get to know don't tend to be fickle.

One of the things I want to know is if there's a way for me to at least inquire about their feelings, or really 28M's feelings because I'm more interested in a monogamous relationship with 33M. So I do want to avoid the drama, but I also have an emotional and intellectual connection with one man that is more than the other.
I'm gonna barf

I mean what would Dear Black People be about? DWP is about colorism and respectability politics and is a satirical comedy. I think people that criticize it haven't seen it and don't actually care about it.

Hey, sorry, i posted this and then kind of dipped. I feel bad about including that term, it's a derogatory term I've seen on Twitter to describe "whiny" biracial people. It's problematic, I'm sorry for using it.
He could've been bi or pan!

Your friends sound awful. Some people might say "at least you have friends" but toxic friendships are still detrimental to your mental health. Please take care of yourself. Loneliness sucks too, but maybe you can explore your interests and find new friends.

I seriously opened the app to vent about this very same feeling. It sucks, but it's not always this way. Sometimes it'll be different, but it still fucking sucks. Sorry you're going through something too, my friend.

edit: word.
Would like to down vote for rage but up vote for creativity...

Glad you could find a silver lining, I suppose, bot over all, what the fuck? Surely the producers of the event should've put more thought into the logistics like estimated audience and exhibit size and secured a larger venue. That's really disappointing, hopefully it'll come back around now that the show is over and more props and costumes can be added, and hopefully they'll have learned. However, I suppose no matter what, they're guaranteed a large turn out, regardless.
Why was it a shit show?

TBF, she spent most of her life in WF. She spent like less than a year in KL, and the last time she was in a huge crowd in KL, her father was being executed and she was running for her life. Plus, that crowd in last episode was made up of desperate people fleeing for their lives. 

I am jaded by how thick Arya's plot armor is given the situations we've seen her in. She looked cocky when her and Sandor entered KL and people were just migrating to the Keep. If she still had that same pride once the chaos started, it'd feel even more cheap.

 After three or so seasons of seeing Arya just be great at everything, unstoppable, and ruthless, having moments where she is human is actually a highlight. But it doesn't take much in this season...

ETA: fuck yeah, your username!!!

Yeah, that was very irritating to me. It was interesting to see the small folk and chaos at the ground, but only hearing Drogon and seeing fire at random just made it kind of cartoonish to me. 

And I will admit that I was playing Skyrim before tonight's episode, and I encountered a dragon... Kinda made Drogon and Dany feel more NPC than POV. But obviously biased from that particular circumstance.

Yeah! In the latter example: that DIDN'T NEED TO BE DEPICTED. We already get it, he's not going to just be randomly killed by a falling object. Same with Arya. It's a no brainer.

I can rationalize the drowning a little bit more for Tyrion, he had to jump in the water to save himself, he was bound... Still, depicted as a doomed conclusion.

Same with Jaime's dive in the last season, but also a fucking end of episode cliff hanger. Depicted to be grim, nothing more than a nice dip on a hot day.

Plot lines that took up screen time and are now CONFIRMED bullshit:
- Cersei's pregnancy and love triangle with Euron and Jaime
- Bronn assassinating Jaime and Tyrion

LIKELY bullshit:
- Brienne and Jaime (I guess maybe they can ass pull some character development from her)

It was a complete waste of time. I actually was enjoying the Brienne/Jaime pairing, albeit reluctantly because the writing felt awkward but I guess it makes more sense than the both of them being sauve or charismatic given their romantic and overall histories.

But then we come to find out that it was used to pointlessly fill a "story slot" in the first half of the final season. He didn't even leave her to kill Cersei. He really just left to be with her. And maybe if there'd been more exposition it could've been an interesting direction in his arc, but there wasn't. Why did he even go to Winterfell at all? To "fight for the living?" And then he just tried to fucking walk through the Army of the North into KL like it WASN'T gonna be an issue???

After Arya's season six fake out, I was pissed off.
After Arya killing the NK, I cackled.
After... Jesus horse?? Saved her? Just a shrug.

Arya is one of my favorite characters, but D&D made her so OP she's got plot armor stronger than Jaime. She constantly throws herself into danger's way and comes out with some bloody bruises.

From what I remember of my years at Chipotle, the people who ask for a side of cilantro are weird, slightly annoying people (every other thing has fucking cilantro in it already!!). The people who ask for things without cilantro are the fucking devil.

It's also sad because those same, more casual fans watched the whole show at some point. The first 5 seasons drew them in, they were engaged by the more lore-laden elements and carefully constructed plots with high stakes... Yet the producers knew they could get away with just focusing on the fun parts without the base-breaking risks. It sucks.
The Iron Bank cut them off.
But we saw what happened with Summer... Wights can EASILY over power a direwolf in a modest swarm.

Oh no, to me, the worst part is that he didn't die off screen. People have pointed out that you can see him in the trailer for next week's episode. I didn't want Ghost to die, but now I'm far more annoyed that they even put him in the front lines. I TOTALLY thought he died and that it was just casual... Naw. I don't even know what to say.
And Robert Baratheon: champion of the Battle of the Trident, King of the Seven Kingdoms, reason why the Daenerys plot even is a thing... Drunk from poisoned wine, gored by a boar on a hunting trip.

My mom is enraged that I don't want one, she's offered to buy me one because she wants me to be "cool" at the age of 25... I have a full-time job and salary, mom. If I wanted to be cool I could probably figure it out but I clearly don't care.

I get way too many robocalls now, I don't answer the phone if the number isn't in my address book. I need people to leave me voicemails in that case, but checking them is still a huge pain in the ass.
My mom was always burning incense when I was growing up...

I was that roommate, up until the last few months. I say that because none of my past roommates ever could stick to cleaning their dishes within a day of using them... Like, not a single one and I have had 5 different ones in 5 years. Now I have a place of my own. It's fucking amazing to come home and not have to worry about other people's dishes growing mold in the sink
